description: KFLT v1 frozen vector for the presence-capability canonical bytes (PROTOCOL.md §5.2), for @forgesworn/tessera-kit. preimageHex/digestHex are independently hand-checked via node:crypto at generation time (see scratchpad/gen-vectors.mjs). sig is a FIXED, already-valid BIP340 signature (frozen once — BIP340 uses random aux by default, so it is not re-derived; only re-VERIFIED, which is fully deterministic) produced by the demo subjectPrivHex below (a labelled deterministic demo key, sha256("tessera-kit vector demo key: capability vector subject (DEMO KEY — not a secret)") — NOT a real secret). This is an OPEN-pool capability (memberValue === subjectPubHex).
